decisions.what_it_tests: Commutativity and associativity of x op y = x^2 + y^2.
decisions.why_this_topic: Properties of binary operations belong to the algebraic-structures part of discrete mathematics (monoids, groups).

decisions.what_it_tests: Which cache lines a block may occupy in a k-way set-associative cache.
decisions.why_this_topic: Set-associative mapping is cache organisation.
decisions.solution_sketch: Set = j mod v; its lines are (j mod v)k ... (j mod v)k + k - 1.
decisions.note: Clear.

decisions.what_it_tests: Handshake lemma facts.

decisions.what_it_tests: Reading a micro-operation sequence: save PC, jump - interrupt entry.

decisions.solution_sketch: PC saved to memory via MBR, PC loaded with Y -> initiation of interrupt service.
decisions.note: CTRL vs IO boundary - either is defensible.

decisions.what_it_tests: Locating the last sector of a contiguous file on a disk.
decisions.why_this_topic: Disk addressing <cylinder, surface, sector> is disk organisation in the OS syllabus.

alternatives_considered.why_not: storage geometry is taught with OS disks

decisions.solution_sketch: 85594 sectors; start offset 9x64+40 = 616 in cylinder 1200; (616+85593)/1024 = 84 -> cylinder 1284.
decisions.note: Clear.
